chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from the one he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him: 'A man has make-up prayers (qada) from the month of Ramadan, and he enters the morning but does not eat until Asr prayer; is it permissible for him to make it make-up from the month of Ramadan?' He said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Can I perform make-up Ramadan prayers while fasting in another month?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the permissibility of performing make-up prayers (qada) from Ramadan while simultaneously observing a fast, such as the voluntary fasts of Shawwal or the six days of Shawwal. The Imam confirms that the presence of outstanding prayers does not invalidate the current fast, provided the intention for fasting is distinct and valid. This ruling highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the accumulation of acts of worship, allowing believers to manage spiritual debts without compromising the validity of new devotions.
